name: DBpedia SPARQL Endpoint
rate_limits: Result sets limited to 10,000 rows. Fair use policy on complex queries. No explicit rate limit documented.
notes: Structured data extracted from Wikipedia. One of the largest open knowledge graphs. Powered by Virtuoso, hosted by OpenLink Software. Supports SPARQL 1.1. Results available in JSON, JSON-LD, TSV, nested JSON via content negotiation. Experimental REST API also available (ontology-driven). Faceted browser at dbpedia.org/fct. Partial results may be returned without error status for complex queries -- must check HTTP headers. Linked Data compatible.
